The Discussion on Whether Obsession is Dissociated from Consciousness.
Is obsession dissociated from consciousness? Yes.
Is form Nibbāna? Is the eye-base …pe… the tangible-object-base Nibbāna?
One should certainly not say so …pe…
Is obsession dissociated from consciousness? Yes.
There is no mind with lust, no mind with hatred, no mind with delusion... [and so forth].
Is an unwholesome mind a defiled mind?
One should not say so … [and so on] … Is it not the case that there is a mind with lust, a mind with hatred, and a mind with delusion … [and so on]?
Is an unwholesome mind a defiled mind? Yes.
Indeed, there is a mind with lust, a mind with hatred, and a mind with delusion... [and so forth].
An unwholesome mind is a defiled mind; indeed, it should not be said that "obsession is dissociated from the mind.
The discussion on the end of the section regarding obsession being dissociated from the mind is finished.
